hooks.prompt: HC-001 Document-First Gate. Read SNAPSHOT.yaml and check the focus section. If both focus.task and focus.issue are empty strings, examine the file being edited from the hook input ($ARGUMENTS). If the file path contains 'docs/', 'tools/', or matches SNAPSHOT.yaml, CLAUDE.md, CONTEXT.md, README.md, or AGENTS.md — respond {"ok": true}. For any other file, respond {"ok": false, "reason": "Document-first rule (HC-001): No active task or issue in SNAPSHOT.yaml focus. Create or update the relevant task/issue before editing code files."}. If focus.task or focus.issue is non-empty, respond {"ok": true}. If SNAPSHOT.yaml does not exist, respond {"ok": true}.

HC-003 Verification Gate. You are reviewing a file edit. The edit details are: $ARGUMENTS

Does this edit set a status to 'done', 'closed', or 'verified' (in SNAPSHOT.yaml item statuses or markdown frontmatter)? Only respond {"ok": false, "reason": "..."} if status is being set TO done/closed/verified. In that case, the reason should remind to verify all linked TST-* notes are status: passing before finalizing (HC-003). If the edit does NOT transition a status to done/closed/verified, respond {"ok": true}.

HC-004 Phase Alignment. You are reviewing a file edit. The edit details are: $ARGUMENTS

Does this edit set a task status to 'doing' (in SNAPSHOT.yaml or markdown frontmatter)? Only respond {"ok": false, "reason": "..."} if a task is being transitioned TO doing. In that case, the reason should remind to verify the task's phase aligns with focus.phase in SNAPSHOT.yaml (HC-004). If the edit does NOT transition a task to doing, respond {"ok": true}.
